body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not always provide a minimum 12-month eligibility period for each child, as required by 98.21(a)(1). (Plan Questions 2.5.2a and 2.5.2c) Overall Target Completion Date: 01/13/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Board staff members will manually adjust the family’s eligibility redetermination date in Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) when a new child in care results in an extended eligibility period. 01/13/2025 2 All children in families with siblings added to an existing CCS case will have a full 12 months of authorization. 01/13/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not limit all family co-payments to seven percent or less of family income, as required by 98.45(l)(3). (Plan Question 3.1.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for portions of this requirement through January 13, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 01/13/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 TWC will implement new co-payment methodology with the launch of TX3C. 01/13/2025 2 All family co-payments will not exceed 7% of family income. 01/13/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). (Plan Question 4.4.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for portions of this requirement through January 13, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 01/13/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Boards will begin paying regulated providers prospectively every two weeks based on enrollment with the launch of TX3C. 01/13/2025 2 All regulated providers (not including relative care providers) are paid prospectively every two weeks based on enrollment. 01/13/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not provide grants or contracts for direct services for infants and toddlers, for children in underserved geographic areas, and for children with disabilities, as required by 98.30(b)(1). (Plan Questions 4.1.1c and 4.5.1i). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for portions of this requirement through April 30, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 04/30/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 TWC Child Care Rules (§809.96) was updated effective July 29, 2024, to allow Boards to contract with providers for direct services for children with disabilities. TWC Child Rules already allowed for Boards to contract with providers for direct services for infants and toddlers and for children in underserved geographic areas. 07/29/2024 2 Develop program parameters for a new statewide initiative to contract for direct services for infants and toddlers, for children in underserved geographic areas, and for children with disabilities. 05/30/2025 3 TWC will update the case management system to allow Boards to manage contracts for direct services. 08/31/2025 4 Implement contracts for direct services for infants and toddlers, for children in underserved geographic areas, and for children with disabilities. 04/30/2026
